title: Affine blow-up chart algebra
statement:
Let $a\in I$. Define $A[I/a]$ to be the $A$-subalgebra of $A_a$
generated by the fractions $x/a$ with $x\in I$.

lean.statement: noncomputable def chartRing : Subalgebra A (Localization.Away a) :=
lean.note: Exact source declaration in the published WeilConjectures affine chart algebra module. It defines the A-subalgebra of Localization.Away a generated by chartFraction a 1 for x : I, which is the node's A[I/a] under its contextual hypothesis a ∈ I. The declaration is intentionally more general in a (it does not bind a membership proof); instantiating it for any a ∈ I gives exactly the stated chart algebra, with no stronger assumptions or changed object.
